svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Web app on AWS
svg.desc: Web app on AWS. 6 components in 3 groups. Connections: Users to Application Load Balancer (HTTPS); Application Load Balancer to Web service; Web service to Amazon Aurora; Web service to Amazon ElastiCache; Web service to Amazon Simple Storage Service.

text.tspan: A container service behind a load balancer, with a database, a cache and file storage
